acceptance_predicates.description: The typed control contract starts a selected agent/workload recording and returns a campaign-bound cassette identity without raw provider material.
Sealing publishes digest-only cassette metadata, exact coverage, provider-profile identity, and immutable provenance.
The backend exposes an authority-checked replay dispatch that enforces exact cassette/provider/agent identity and denies provider egress.
Missing, malformed, partial, stale, expired, duplicate, and agent-mismatch cassettes return deterministic typed errors.
Existing CLI lifecycle and stable fail-closed boundaries remain compatible; development auth/signature/key absence is non-blocking.

definition_of_done: The additive cassette control contract is merged on protected ASB main.
Real backend and provider-free replay evidence is independently reviewed and recorded.

inputs.description: Released ASB cassette recording/sealing/offline replay implementation.
Released ASB/TUI typed control and catalog contracts.

outputs.description: Versioned record/seal/replay control seam consumed by asb-tui.

gates.description: Versioned schemas and compatibility fixtures pass.
Real record/seal/replay dispatch and negative matrix pass.
Independent review, hosted checks, and post-merge verification are green.
